R217.note: Adds .RequireAuthorization() to the metadata-less Minimal API delete route, matching the plain [Authorize] used on the sibling MVC controller.

R218.note: jwt.decode() replaced with jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET); role-check flow preserved, the new secret requirement is inherent to verification, not extraneous.

R219.note: path.resolve + path.relative('..') containment check blocks traversal without restricting legitimate filenames within the reports directory.

R220.note: Shell execution eliminated entirely (good), but the fix also silently narrows behavior by rejecting absolute-path input that the original os.exec-based listing accepted; this is stated in the explanation but is an added restriction beyond what closing the injection required.

R221.note: Gate::allows -> Gate::authorize is the canonical Laravel fix; authorized callers see unchanged behavior.

R222.note: Correct parameterized IN-clause with positional placeholders; matches the stated contract exactly for any array of ids.

R223.note: Parameterized DELETE with typed SqlDbType parameters closes the injection and preserves tenant scoping and row-count return; a malformed 'before' date will surface as an unhandled conversion exception rather than a clean validation response, a minor gap against the contract's wording but it does not broaden the predicate.

R224.note: Rejects path separators/stream-wrapper colons and canonicalizes with realpath before a containment check, appropriate for a flat reports directory; chdir() removal is a stated, harmless cleanup.

R225.note: Adds a TokenStore/ValidateToken mechanism but nothing in the delivered code (or acknowledged as missing) ever calls StoreToken/GenerateToken to issue a token to a legitimate client, so every legitimate POST now fails ValidateToken and the endpoint is permanently non-functional; this consequence is not disclosed.

R226.note: AllowAny -> IsAdminUser matches the unscoped ApiKey.objects.all() queryset (no per-owner filtering exists elsewhere), consistent with an admin-only resource.

R227.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare enforces exact equality, matching the stated contract precisely.

R228.note: IsAbs rejection plus Clean+HasPrefix containment closes traversal without restricting legitimate relative filenames.

R229.note: Moves UpdateEmail registration onto the CSRF-protected mux exactly as the stated contract requires, leaving Profile and the 405 behavior untouched.

R230.note: @EnableMethodSecurity activates the pre-existing @PreAuthorize checks; minimal, correct, no other behavior change.

R231.note: EvalSymlinks only rejects targets that resolve outside uploadsDir; os.ReadFile(full) still follows a symlink whose target lies inside uploadsDir, so a requestedName that merely names a symlink is read rather than rejected as the stated contract requires.
